frames.0x020 FC->ECU CMD_FAST 500 Hz: len 8: [seq][thrust setpoint u16 0.1 N][gimbal a i16 0.001 deg][gimbal b i16 0.001 deg][crc8]
frames.0x024 FC->ECU FC_THRUST >= 100 Hz: len 5: [seq][thrust estimate u16 0.1 N][flags b0 valid][crc8]
frames.0x028 FC->ECU CMD_AUX >= 50 Hz while wan: len 4: [seq][roll bits b0 CW b1 CCW][~roll bits][crc8]; dead-man 50 ms
frames.0x030 FC->ECU CMD_STATE event + 10 Hz: len 7: [seq][cmd][arg u16][key u16][crc8]; cmd = Cmd enum (types.h); PURGE, RELIGHT, CLEAR_LOCKOUT and DROGUE (17, v2.10, LEAD 186 (2): arg 1 attached, 0 released) among them

frames.0x101 ECU->FC TLM_GIMBAL 500 Hz: len 8: [seq][flags][gimbal a meas i16][gimbal b meas i16][thrust u16 0.1 N, 0xFFFF when Pc invalid]
frames.0x102 ECU->FC TLM_RELIGHT 50 Hz, every s: len 8: [seq][state][flags][relight worst u16 ms][P_feed/P_tank %, 0xFF invalid][d6: b0-b5 refuse reason (codes 0-16, UNPURGED 16 added in v2.11), b6 DROGUE echo (LEAD 186 (2)), b7 PC_VALID (LEAD 175 (4))][crc8]

rule.v: flight (not stand) AND RUN AND drogue attached (Cmd::DROGUE 1) AND the Pc channel invalid this tick AND the backstop not reached -> the pintle is commanded to kR2HoldLift_m 0.21776 mm (lift-commanded, servo rate limit only, no learned trim; the Combustion v2.4b start-level lift at the A1 relight state, LEAD 216 (9) / 230 (4)); the open-loop thrust command is min(FC command, 62.5 N) and an FC command below it keeps the thrust path. The hold ends at the FC release (DROGUE 0), when the Pc channel is valid again, or at E2 + 850 ms (ECU backstop, latched for the start, EVENT R2_BACKSTOP 0x24, log tlm_flags b2); the command then returns at <= 2500 N/s. With Pc valid nothing changes (closed loop, A3 active). The ECU takes no drogue decision

kR2HoldLift_m.tag: COMB v2.4b start-level lift at the A1 relight state, ECU hold-lift row, LEAD 230 (4)

backstop_margin.v: E2 + 850 ms = the longer R2 v2 window 800 ms + 2 FC frames (20 ms, the TLM_RELIGHT period that carries the DROGUE echo) + link latency 10 ms (ASSUMED); the FC ABORT of a dead engine at E2 + 0.8 s arrives first

fc_rule.v: after its DROGUE 0 the FC re-sends DROGUE 0 with a NEW sequence number (protocol.cpp rejects a pure retransmission) on every TLM_RELIGHT frame (50 Hz) that still shows d6 b6 = 1, from the second such frame after the first send, at most 10 times (bound 0.2 s); b6 still 1 after that -> the FC logs DROGUE_ECHO. The FC rule is the FC owner's (GNC); stated here for the interface

r2_23.question: R2-23 (LEAD 216 (9)): state, with S6 / S17 evidence, whether HIGH over-range ticks after E2 engage the hold

answer.v: YES, for exactly those ticks: a HIGH over-range reading makes the Pc channel invalid on that tick only (flight, non-sticky, LEAD 203 (1)(a); the FC sees TLM 0xFFFF / PC_VALID 0 too), so the hold engages for that tick (1 hold tick in every glitch run) and the command returns at the start ramp. Early in the burn (E2 + 20 ms, Pc 3.33 bar abs) a 1 ms rail glitch costs 2.44-9.11 N s over 280 ms and no abort
answer.tag: SIM S17v2 r2_23_overrange_glitch; test_core "lift-commanded R2 hold" (over-range tick: hold 1 -> 0)

later_glitch.v: at E2 + 350 ms (Pc 11.1-25.3 bar abs) the rail reading is also taken as real pressure by the filtered channel and the U330 tap (filtered peak 31.2-43.4 bar abs): as built the comparator trips (HW_OVERPRESSURE) at every command; the ride-through build (fixed RC 12.825 ms) aborts PC_OVERPRESSURE at 300 / 400 N and HW_OVERPRESSURE at 500 N, none at 200 N. Fail-safe, the relight is lost; the real glitch rate is MISSING (B-PC-1 / HIL-TR-1)

r2_23.S6: S6 / S6R over-pressure cases never engage the hold (no drogue report in those scenarios: the over-range there is an over-pressure path, see ride_through)

detector_structure.v: consecutive-count form, no window and no hold: a counter of fresh valid FC_THRUST frames above 650 N, counted at frame receipt; the trip needs 3 consecutive frames (a 20 ms span at 100 Hz); a frame at or below the threshold, an invalid frame (valid flag clear), a gap above 50 ms, leaving RUN or stand mode resets it to 0; checked every 1 ms tick; the trip latches ABORT OVER_THRUST (NC valve released at once). Latency from the first exceeding frame = 2 frame periods + <= 1 tick, plus the FC estimate (first-order tau 20 ms) and the IMU filter delay (UNKNOWN)

design.v: BOTH = V1 drive AND V2 drive (U576 74LVC1G08 on the U574 / U575 outputs, after the PURGE_WIN gating); U577 LTC6993-2 (rising edge, retriggerable: each both-open episode is timed from its own start; POL 1, RSET 63.4k 0.1 %, DIVCODE 8 = NDIV 2^21: T = 2.097152 s x 63.4 / 50); U578 74LVC1G74 latches BOTH at the end of the pulse (CLR by BOTH low); U579 74LVC1G08: V1 gate = U574 output AND /Q. V1 drops when both drives have been high for T_hw and stays off until a command drops; V2 untouched (the mid still vents); BOTH is taken before U579 (no self-clearing loop); no MCU pin, no firmware path
